name: Abjuration Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Shield; Lesser Restoration; Protection from Energy; Banishment; Mass Cure Wounds. After an Abjuration spell cast with a slot, you or a visible creature within 30 feet gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the slot level.

benefits.name: School Benefit
benefits.summary: After an Abjuration spell cast with a slot, you or a visible creature within 30 feet gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the slot level.
benefits.text: After you cast an Abjuration spell with a spell slot, you or a creature you can see within 30 feet gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the slot's level. The game gives them to the spell's ally target with the fewest Hit Points, or to you when the spell has no other ally target.
